title: One buffer fill step
statement: Let $E$ be an injective code from optional $[0m[0m\Gamma$ symbols into blocks of $N+1$ optional bits, and let $r$ assign a scanned symbol or blank to each of $k$ tapes. For an offset $j\in\{0,\ldots,N\}$, updating entry $j$ of each tape's buffer after $j$ reading steps to the corresponding entry of its coded symbol produces the buffer after $j+1$ reading steps.
hypotheses_covered: Injective block code $E$ for optional $[0m[0m\Gamma$ symbols
